core_obligations: Note faithful flatness of the two maps (proof lines 11078-11079).
Derive the implication from the henselizations by descent (proof lines 11079-11080).
Derive the converse from the colimit presentation by smooth algebras (proof lines 11081-11085).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that reducedness of a local ring is equivalent to reducedness of its henselization and of its strict henselization. The statement carries a slogan recording that reducedness passes to the henselizations. The proof notes that the two maps are faithfully flat, so one direction follows from descent of reducedness, and for the converse uses that the henselizations are filtered colimits of etale, hence smooth, algebras, so that reducedness ascends from the ring.
